Retail brand of BRK Brands (Aurora, Illinois) for smoke and CO alarms, home extinguishers, EZ Fire Spray and escape ladders; owned by Resideo.
UK brand of an all-fires liquid extinguisher (classes A, B, F, electrical and lithium-ion) sold in 500 ml, 2 and 6 litre sizes plus a pan-fire sachet.
Norfolk extinguisher manufacturer (BS EN3) known for the P50 composite service-free range in water mist, foam, powder, F-class and AVD lithium-battery agents.

notes: Eight old extinguisher kinds (k54–k61) collapsed into one tier kind 'Fire extinguisher' with agent as types; the old safelincs source replaced by the retrieved Wikipedia article. Fire blanket kept (k62) with Wikipedia source. New kind 'Fire escape ladder' sourced from the retrieved Safelincs Kidde ladder page (two- and three-storey lengths), with First Alert EL52-2 from the retrieved First Alert store page. Models limited to household brands named in the brief (Kidde, First Alert, Firexo, Britannia Fire, Jactone) plus the SafeWise test winner (Amerex B402) and StoveTop FireStop as the automatic stove-top example; no trade service kit, signs, stands or brackets. Amerex and StoveTop FireStop appear only as model makers, not in the brand register, because no page about those brands was retrieved (Amerex Wikipedia fetch failed). Jactone's own site was blocked (url_not_allowed), so its register entry cites a retrieved retailer page; founding years for Firexo, Britannia Fire and Jactone left blank as unconfirmed. Prepared Hero fire blanket omitted (Amazon page not retrievable). No traditions apply to this shelf.
